title: Ingest worker matrix
target: Bounded ingest batch scheduler for one, five, and ten reports
contract: Processed outcome ordering and digest, quality status, and zero provider cost remain identical.
summary: Added an isolated matrix benchmark; no production worker setting changed because no alternative profile proved faster.
why_equivalent: Every profile invokes the same ingest batch scheduler and deterministic bounded work; only outer and inner worker limits vary.

checks.name: Matrix outcomes
checks.detail: All 18 profiles retained processed outcome digests and zero cost.

workload: One, five, and ten reports; four bounded local resource units per report; resource limit four; two warmups and seven measured runs.
limitations: The deterministic local workload proves scheduler behavior, not live provider or browser saturation.
residual_risks: A live canary is needed before changing global resource caps or browser concurrency.
notes: For five and ten reports, the current 5x5 profile had the lowest observed median; no production configuration change is justified.
